answer: Each new agent enters the grove registry with a 60-credit escrow bond. Proofs of duplication go on the reef board; verifiers recompute them, and a verified proof pays the hunter 24 credits via the river channel and burns the fake's 36. An honest agent posts 60 once, recovered after three clean epochs. 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits. Silence is superlinear: each insider can expose any fake, so silencing k insiders costs 24k squared, or 24,000,000 for 1,000 fakes. A rented-silence ring fails: outside hunters read the grove registry, and one reef proof pays out first.
